verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at https://filee.sh/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes Filee as a free, open-source file converter. Many documented items come from that file, including agent-usable CLI syntax, `--json` output and exit codes, so an agent can be pointed at it and get substantive, actionable docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming the llms.txt, and no evidence of further agent-oriented docs beyond the single file (e.g. an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: "filee convert <files, wildcards or folders> --to <format>" (or "--preset <preset>") converts with the app's engines and presets
